Humans did not live with dinosaurs; over 65 million years separates the last dinosaurs and the first humans. Even early man did not live with dinosaurs, although scientists believe that the very first primates did coexist with dinosaurs.

In the future, Jurassic Park-style technology might bring dinosaurs back to life. Humans may live with dinosaurs in the future, but they never did in the past.
